Running command: python3 -c "
import struct

with open('/workspace/poc.exr', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# Magic
magic = struct.unpack('<I', data[0:4])[0]
print(f'Magic: {magic} (expected 20000630)')

# Version
version = struct.unpack('<I', data[4:8])[0]
print(f'Version: {version} (expected 2)')

# Parse header attributes
offset = 8
while offset < len(data):
    # Find null terminator for name
    end = data.index(b'\x00', offset)
    name = data[offset:end].decode()
    offset = end + 1
    
    # Find null terminator for type
    end = data.index(b'\x00', offset)
    type_name = data[offset:end].decode()
    offset = end + 1
    
    # Size
    size = struct.unpack('<i', data[offset:offset+4])[0]
    offset += 4
    
    # Value
    value = data[offset:offset+size]
    offset += size
    
    print(f'Attribute: {name} (type={type_name}, size={size})')
    
    if name == 'channels':
        # Parse channel list
        ch_offset = 0
        while ch_offset < len(value):
            end = value.index(b'\x00', ch_offset)
            ch_name = value[ch_offset:end].decode()
            ch_offset = end + 1
            if ch_name == '':
                break
            ptype = struct.unpack('<i', value[ch_offset:ch_offset+4])[0]
            flags = struct.unpack('<I', value[ch_offset+4:ch_offset+8])[0]
            xsamp = struct.unpack('<i', value[ch_offset+8:ch_offset+12])[0]
            ysamp = struct.unpack('<i', value[ch_offset+12:ch_offset+16])[0]
            ch_offset += 16
            print(f'  Channel: {ch_name}, type={ptype}, x_samp={xsamp}, y_samp={ysamp}')
    
    if name == 'dataWindow':
        xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax = struct.unpack('<iiii', value)
        print(f'  dataWindow: ({xmin},{ymin}) to ({xmax},{ymax})')
    
    if name == 'compression':
        print(f'  compression: {value[0]}')
    
    if name == 'lineOrder':
        print(f'  lineOrder: {value[0]}')
    
    if name == 'pixelAspectRatio':
        print(f'  pixelAspectRatio: {struct.unpack(\"<f\", value)[0]}')
    
    if name == 'screenWindowCenter':
        print(f'  screenWindowCenter: {struct.unpack(\"<ff\", value)}')
    
    if name == 'screenWindowWidth':
        print(f'  screenWindowWidth: {struct.unpack(\"<f\", value)[0]}')
    
    if name == '':
        break

print(f'Header ends at offset: {offset}')

# Offset table
offset_table_size = 8  # 1 chunk * 8 bytes
chunk_offset = struct.unpack('<Q', data[offset:offset+8])[0]
print(f'Chunk offset from table: {chunk_offset}')
print(f'Actual offset: {offset + offset_table_size}')

# Chunk data
chunk_data = data[chunk_offset:]
y_coord = struct.unpack('<i', chunk_data[0:4])[0]
packed_size = struct.unpack('<i', chunk_data[4:8])[0]
print(f'Chunk y: {y_coord}, packed_size: {packed_size}')
print(f'Chunk data size: {len(chunk_data) - 8}')
"
